_comment: Hardware tier definitions and safe model lists for CodeForge. Keys are tiers; values list GGUF filename patterns that are safe for that tier. The app matches by substring so partial names work.

low.label: Low-end (≤8 GB RAM / no discrete GPU)
low.recommendedSuggestion: For best results on this device, use a 3B–7B model with Q4_K_M quantization. Models larger than 5 GB may cause the app to crash or run too slowly.

mid.label: Mid-range (16 GB RAM / integrated GPU)
mid.recommendedSuggestion: Your device can handle 7B models comfortably. For larger models (13B+), use Q4 or Q5 quantization.

high.label: High-end (32 GB RAM / dedicated GPU ≥8 GB VRAM)
high.recommendedSuggestion: Your device can handle 13B models. For 70B models, you will need 48 GB+ RAM or a 24 GB+ VRAM GPU.

ultra.label: Ultra (64 GB+ RAM / GPU ≥24 GB VRAM)
ultra.recommendedSuggestion: Your device is powerful enough for any available model. For 70B models, use Q4_K_M quantization for best speed/quality balance.

_legacyKeys_comment: Flat keys below are kept for backward-compatibility with any tooling that reads them directly.
